verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a cloud compute platform, but the evidence pack documents no account-wide data export in open formats. OpenTelemetry export of traces and metrics is an adjacent observability feature, not an export of all user data. The Python, JS and Go SDKs are developer building blocks, not an export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
